description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal plugin class 'TextField' for migrating Drupal 7 text fields, including methods for determining field formatter type, widget type, and field type with logic for handling plain text and filtered text instances.

classes.name: TextField
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for migrating Drupal 7 text fields, with methods to determine field formatter, widget, and type, handling different text processing settings.

methods.name: getFieldFormatterType
methods.description: Determines the formatter type for a field based on its source properties and field type.

methods.name: getFieldWidgetType
methods.description: Determines the widget type for a field based on its source properties and field type.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Determines the field type, possibly skipping migration if conflicting text processing settings are detected.
